description: This file defines the Category model class for the OpenCart admin project, providing methods for CRUD operations on categories, including managing descriptions, paths, filters, stores, layouts, SEO URLs, and hierarchical category relationships.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Model class for managing categories in the OpenCart admin system, handling database interactions for CRUD operations, hierarchical relationships, SEO URLs, filters, store assignments, layouts, and descriptions.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Creates a new category record in the database, including descriptions, paths, filters, store assignments, SEO URLs, and layout settings.

methods.name: editCategory
methods.description: Updates an existing category record, recalculates hierarchical paths, SEO URLs, filters, stores, and layout configurations.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Changes the status (enabled/disabled) of a category in the database.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category and all associated descriptions, filters, paths, SEO URLs, store, and layout data, including cascading deletes for related products and coupons.

methods.name: repairCategories
methods.description: Repairs category hierarchies by re-establishing correct paths for all categories recursively.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific category, including its path expression.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Fetches a list of categories based on filtering criteria such as name, status, parent, store, and language.

methods.name: getTotalCategories
methods.description: Returns the total count of categories matching specified filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a new description entry for a specific category in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all description entries for a given category.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a particular language across categories.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a specific category, indexed by language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all category descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Creates a new hierarchical path record for a category.

methods.name: deletePaths
methods.description: Removes all path records associated with a given category.

methods.name: deletePathsByLevel
methods.description: Deletes category path records below a certain level.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the concatenated string of path IDs for a category.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves all path records for a category, ordered by level.

methods.name: getPathsByPathId
methods.description: Gets all path records sharing the same path ID.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Associates a filter with a category.

methods.name: deleteFilters
methods.description: Removes all filters linked to a category.

methods.name: deleteFiltersByFilterId
methods.description: Deletes filter association records by filter ID.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves all filter IDs associated with a category.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a category with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes store associations from a category.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all category associations for a specific store.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves store IDs associated with a category.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates a layout with a category for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Removes all layout associations from a category.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Removes all category associations for a specific layout.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all layout associations for a specific store.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves layout IDs associated with a category per store.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts the number of categories using a specific layout.
